$schema_doc: Placement constraints for the 12MHz crystal (Y1) and load caps (C5, C6) near the RP2040 (U3) XIN/XOUT pins. Run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_crystal_placement.py`. RP2040 datasheet 2.9.1: 'Place the crystal as close to XIN as possible'.

constraints.rationale: Crystal placed as close as possible to U3 XIN (pin 20) per RP2040 datasheet 2.9.1. Keeps oscillator loop impedance and parasitic coupling controlled.
Crystal load cap on XIN side. Must be tight to Y1 pin 1 for correct oscillator tuning.
Crystal load cap on XOUT side. Must be tight to Y1 pin 3 for correct oscillator tuning.
